opening.text: Across Finland, language, anxiety, distance and missing paperwork
can put care out of reach,
so we're bringing the first conversation into familiar places, closer to home.

welcome.text: Edge Care is a physical iPad kiosk for libraries and community centres.
Walk up and talk to Edi, powered by Gemini.

research.text: An optional voice sample supports clinician review.

handoff.text: A signature and four digits protect the handoff, designed for single use with Solana.

doctor.text: At the doctor, ElevenLabs turns two languages into one conversation.

crm.text: Referrals, visits and follow-up come together.
Public Finnish data reveals access gaps.
Test where another doctor, interpreter or mobile clinic could help.

guidance.text: Edi summarises your symptoms and recommends the next step.
Here, the referral is high priority: speak to a medical professional as soon as possible.

tour-intro.text: In the digital twin, explore how far people travel, where doctor capacity is stretched, and who may need an interpreter.

tour-mobile.text: Then simulate a mobile clinic, and compare where it could help most.
